data.topic: Do the READMEs, AGENTS.md, CROSS-CLI.md, runtime sync docs, skill and command docs, feature catalogs and manual testing playbooks across the repo describe the current eleven agents (.skilled/agents/*.md and agent-registry.json) and their runtime copies (.claude, .codex, .cursor, .devin, .dsh, .opencode, .pi, .vibe agent folders) correctly?
